raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE JP Morgan Chase & Co., Bangalore, Manager – Business Analyst into capital market and fund services Key Deliverables:
07/2017 - 12/2025
Fund Services & Client Migration (Instruction Capture)
Led end-to-end client onboarding and migration projects using Agile methodology, ensuring successful implementation of new fund
services platforms and operational workflows.
Gathered, documented, and analyzed business requirements through BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and stakeholder workshops. Managed requirement traceability from analysis through testing, deployment, and post-production support. Conducted detailed functional analysis of instruction capture platforms, identifying process optimization opportunities and operational
efficiencies.
Created and executed over 200 UAT and functional test cases covering SWIFT processing, trade instructions, settlement flows, and
accounting validations.
Worked extensively on SWIFT MT54X, MT304, MT2XX, and MT1XX message formats, validating trade confirmation and settlement
processing requirements.
Supported migration initiatives involving Client Defined Format (CDF) implementation and standardized payment file format conversions. Coordinated defect triage meetings and collaborated with Operations, Technology, and Vendor teams to resolve critical production
issues.
Performed data validation, file mapping verification, and end-to-end workflow testing to ensure successful client onboarding. Supported deployment planning, production cutovers, post-implementation validation, and business sign-offs for multiple client
migrations.
Data Governance & Regulatory Reporting
Supported enterprise-wide Data Ǫuality Management (DǪM) and Regulatory Reporting initiatives across Financial Markets and Coverage
businesses.
Conducted business impact assessments and gap analyses to identify data quality issues, compliance breaches, and control weaknesses
affecting regulatory reporting.
Leveraged strong understanding of the Front-to-Back Trade Lifecycle, including trade capture, confirmation, settlement, valuation, and
reporting processes.
Defined and documented data lineage, metadata standards, data dictionaries, ownership models, and control frameworks to strengthen
governance practices.
Collaborated with business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze upstream data feed issues and production defects impacting
reporting accuracy.
Performed root cause analysis on regulatory reporting exceptions and translated business requirements into actionable JIRA stories and
enhancement requests.
Partnered with Strategy, Technology, and Operations teams to implement data quality remediation initiatives within AXIOM and CAPRI
reporting platforms.
Facilitated governance forums and stakeholder discussions to prioritize remediation efforts and improve regulatory reporting controls. Monitored DǪM metrics and reporting KPIs, driving continuous improvements in data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Supported audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation, evidence, and control assessments related to data governance
processes.
Reconciliation Migration (Artemis to IRECS)
Led the Artemis to IRECS reconciliation migration initiative, gathering business requirements and translating them into functional
specifications for OTC Position, OTC Cash, and OTC Valuation reconciliations.
Conducted detailed gap analysis between legacy Artemis and target IRECS platforms, identifying process improvements and functional
enhancements.
Analysed BRDs, technical design documents, and existing reconciliation logic to replicate business rules, calculations, and exception
management within IRECS.
Performed data mapping, reconciliation validation, and output comparison between source and target systems to ensure migration
accuracy. Identified reconciliation discrepancies and root causes, collaborating with technology and product teams to implement corrective actions before production go-live.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops and requirement-gathering sessions, ensuring alignment between Operations, Technology, Product
Owners, and Business Users.
Authored comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and requirement traceability matrices covering end-to-end reconciliation workflows. Led Functional Testing, Regression Testing, SIT, and UAT activities, ensuring successful migration and operational readiness. Managed defect lifecycle through JIRA, including defect logging, prioritization, tracking, retesting, and closure validation. Supported production deployment activities, post-go-live validation, and stabilization phases, ensuring smooth transition from Artemis
to IRECS.
State Street HCL Services Ltd., Coimbatore, Specialist – Client Onboarding & Reference Data Management | Key Deliverables:
09/2015 – 05/2017
Led end-to-end client onboarding lifecycle, including KYC/AML checks, documentation validation, and account setup, ensuring
compliance with regulatory requirements.
Streamlined onboarding workflows by identifying process gaps and implementing automation and standardization initiatives, improving
efficiency
Managed DTC & LATAM settlements and Reference Data Management team consisting of 14 members. Streamlined onboarding and account setup processes across multiple stages using Omgeo ALERT, Global Reference Data system, and
Global Trade management, enhancing workflow efficiency.
New account setup in GRS (Fund to custodian, Destination Records included SWIFT & FAX MT54X, MT304, MT2XX messaging) which
helps the custody receive SWIFT message for trade confirmation.
Ensured timely settlement by Setting up the Party Portfolio ID to Trade Processing Group Mapping, Custodian Data seeding table, ETC
Auto Affirm Portfolio, GTM Agent Bank ID Affirm in GTM Tools.
Ensured all procedures are followed when received the Custodian change & Scheduled changes request in relevant systems for smooth
trade settlement.
Ensured all Market opening tasks are activated in ALERT (Securities Equity & Fixed Income SSIs, FX, OTC SSIs). Ensured all Dead Accounts are removed from ALERT, GRS and GTM. Ensured sufficient coverage from AUS to NY market time zones. Coordinated daily with brokers, custodians, trade support, middle office, account transition, reconciliation. Reviewed, investigated, and analysed alerts generated by surveillance systems, handling escalations and feedback routing.
Tata Consultancy Services, Bangalore, Senior Analyst – Client Onboarding & Reference data
01/2013– 08/2015
Key Deliverables: Facilitated account openings for various counterparties, including UBS, Goldman Sachs, and Blackrock, within the LSE. Handled client queries, provided break-fix solutions, performed root cause analysis, and validated settlement instructions via SWIFT portals to ensure accurate transaction processing.
Handled account opening, maintenance, and tasks for Deutsche Bank (London & US region). Multiple asset class setup of cash and securities for basic and exchange data as per the client needs. Sources emails and dB CAR. Source settlement instructions from alert, company websites and liaise with Middle Office and client for the counter party's settlement
instructions.
Provided data access to internal clients via applications including eSpear, EDI, Global One, Fidessa with update SSI, and DB Trader. Handling Pre and post equity settlement accounts of the clients Account and Carry out Internal Audits within teams. Prepared MIS
reports based on client requirements, calculating team and individual performance for management.
Presented decks which includes capturing the volumes daily, error reports and root cause analysis.
JP Morgan Chase, Bangalore, Team Member – Fund Accounting
01/2012 – 11/2012
Key Deliverables:
Delivered fund services, reconciling trades between recap and WINS to ensure accurate financial reporting. Maintained accounting records, reviewed advisor information, custody records, and broker statements. Analysed financial records for errors and discrepancies, coordinating with the Boston team to resolve issues. Reviewed daily exception reports, researched trade validity, and ensured all trades were accounted for NAV
calculation. Responsible for researching the validity of trades with sources like Bloomberg.
Run the purchase & sale report to check whether all trades are match with the recap.
